rubric: The first line works as a hook on its own; the facts (what, when, where, how much) follow; one call to action closes it.
Length fits the platform (X under 280 characters, Instagram under 150 words, LinkedIn 80 to 200 words, a listing with title and fact lines).
3 to 5 real hashtags where they belong, none on LinkedIn job posts beyond 2 or in WhatsApp; emoji only when the tone is casual, none on LinkedIn or listings.
The user's own voice, no marketing words, no invented prices, dates, links or discounts.
One post, complete; a one-line offer of variants at most.
